## Intent — what this is for

Picks up what WF2LEA-9 Part 4 named as its own atom: procedural_priors() was an inert reader with two live writers, and record_procedural's declared `denied` outcome was a value only synthesize_failures READ. Adds the ambient reader (mapped onto the existing `lesson` kind, not a sixth), gives `denied` a live writer at the native runtime's outcome seam, and removes `corrected` from the contract.

## Done when

procedural_priors() has a production reader — MemoryService.procedural_block() produced in context.build_session_context and rendered by learning.ambient as a named block mapped onto the EXISTING `lesson` kind (no sixth kind, so no sixth slot), competing inside the one learning.context_budget_tokens budget rather than appending beside it; a raw "→ failed"/"→ denied" row is NEVER surfaced (it is synthesize_failures INPUT; the collapsed prior is the durable form) so the block cannot degrade into a tool-call log, the block is capped at 5 lines by its producer, and is_environment_failure_claim is applied on the READ side too because record_procedural's `detail` lands in the prior text; `denied` gains a live writer — the native runtime labels a refused call using security.is_denial_observation, a recogniser that sits beside classify_denial (the single author of all five denial paths' wording) instead of a second copy of its strings — feeding the "→ denied" cluster read synthesize_failures already performed, while the failure breaker still sees `failed`; `corrected` is REMOVED rather than given a synthetic writer (the correction signal is the user's reaction to the PREVIOUS turn and nothing carries that turn's tool set forward, so any writer would blame the wrong tools) and PROCEDURAL_OUTCOMES is a closed set record_procedural raises on and the drain drops+logs on; the surfacing decision is exhaustive over that set with no default branch; heat may rank priors while the decay kernel's eviction verdict never does (asserted through the new block); render's "nothing may crowd out a lesson" rail discriminates by KEY not kind, with the measured non-vacuity case (at a 60-token budget only the prior block survived, and a kind-only check printed the lesson header over it); and the WHOLE chain — capture through the live writer, promotion through the live promote_by_heat, priors, block, and the block inside a real build_session_context — is driven in one test

**Notes:** The strongest design idea here is the one the clause states negatively: a raw '→ failed' / '→ denied' row is never surfaced, because it is synthesize_failures INPUT and the collapsed prior is the durable form.
